mail.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:
verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.preheader: One click and your Todo account is ready.
verify.headline: Confirm your email address
verify.body: Welcome! To confirm your address and sign in, use the button below. The link works for 24 hours.
verify.note_ignore: If you did not create an account, ignore this email.
verify.reason: You received this email because someone signed up for Todo with this address.
reset.subject: Reset your Todo password
reset.preheader: Choose a new password. The link expires in one hour.
reset.headline: Choose a new password
reset.body: To choose a new password, use the button below. The link works for one hour.
reset.note_ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
reset.reason: You received this email because a new password was requested for this address.
exists.subject: You already have a Todo account
exists.preheader: Someone tried to sign up with your address.
exists.headline: You already have an account
exists.body: Someone, hopefully you, tried to create an account with this address, which already has one.
exists.body_forgot: If you forgot your password, choose a new one with the button below.
exists.note_ignore: If this was not you, ignore this email: nothing changed.
exists.reason: You received this email because a sign-up was attempted with this address.
invite.subject: {actor} invited you to Todo
invite.preheader: A calm, fast task list for you and the people you work with.
invite.headline: {actor} invited you to Todo
invite.body: {actor} would like to count you among their contacts on the team’s task list, but this address has no account yet.
invite.body_create: Create your account with this address to answer the request.
invite.note_ignore: If you do not know this person, ignore this email.
invite.reason: You received this email because {actor} invited {email} to Todo.
due_soon.subject: Due soon: {title}
due_soon.preheader: One of your tasks is due soon.
due_soon.headline: Due soon
due_soon.reason: You received this email because this task is yours. You get one reminder per due date.
